# Kendrix

> Kendrix is a storytelling operating system for independent video creators — an opinionated,
> end-to-end workflow that turns one idea into a finished, narrated video, with the creator
> directing and approving every step.

Kendrix handles the production crafts — writing, storyboarding, narration, music, sound design and
assembly — for YouTube and short-form platforms. AI does that production work, but it's an
implementation detail: the product is the workflow, and the standard it holds every story to.

Kendrix is NOT an AI chatbot, an AI prompt wrapper, an AI video generator, a collection of
disconnected AI tools, or a template library. It produces video, but the video is the output of a
storytelling workflow, not the product's identity.

Kendrix is built for independent creators making story-driven video — horror, children's stories,
history and documentary, education, and other narrative genres — who publish consistently and want
to stay in creative control. It's designed around one person doing the whole job, not a team.

As of August 2026, Kendrix is in development and not publicly available. Access is invite-only;
request one from the homepage.

- [Contact](https://kendrix.io/contact): reach the studio directly.
- [Privacy](https://kendrix.io/privacy): what Kendrix collects and why.
- [Terms](https://kendrix.io/terms): terms for using Kendrix during its invite-only beta.
